notes: Co-Pilot awareness gives grounded route, danger, combat, resource, objective, extraction, and workflow guidance from the current game view.
Five distinct companions now mix useful observations with personality-specific reactions to funny, strange, tense, and memorable gameplay moments.
Expanded to 180 curated game profiles with at least 800 scenario responses each—more than 144,000 supported scenario variants.
Companions never ask players to take, upload, attach, or share screenshots; automatic screen analysis uses the current game view.
Screen awareness includes Off, Minimal, Balanced, and Co-Pilot choices, with explicit consent required before hosted vision can be enabled.
Observed frames are processed for the current response and are not stored as companion memory or shared with Crew.
This alpha update preserves existing settings, companion memories, friend state, and local databases.
Alpha software can still miss context; use the in-app feedback path to report incorrect guidance or game coverage gaps.
